blocks.text: Sources for what’s nearby each building

items.t: Beach Grove is the waterfront pocket of Tsawwassen in the City of Delta, on the Boundary Bay shore south of 12 Avenue along Beach Grove Road.
The City's own flood project defines the pocket's shore: the Beach Grove Seawall runs approximately 1.2 kilometres between 12 Avenue and 17A Avenue along Boundary Bay's western shorefront.
Beach Grove Park at 6051 17A Avenue and Beach Grove Elementary at 5955 17A Avenue anchor the inland side of the pocket.
Boundary Beach and Point Roberts, in the United States, lie to the south, and Tsawwassen Central is inland to the west.

The waterfront lots are zoned RD2 (Duplex/Single Detached Residential 2) at the confirmed sample, 1728 Beach Grove Road: the Delta zone sheet states RD2 is the zone for waterfront lots in Beach Grove and carries a 4,000 square metre minimum lot size for subdivision.

The City's seawall design form refers to a "Revised Design Height for Beach Grove Seawall" study and to Boundary Bay Village erosion studies, which is the City's own record that this shore's houses sit behind an engineered seawall rather than a natural beach bank.

blocks.text: Beach Grove: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Hazard Development Permit Area SD3, Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands, in Official Community Plan (OCP) Bylaw No. 8400, Appendix B, sets a minimum floor level of 2.9 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada datum, a minimum land surface elevation of 2.3 metres around construction, and no building within 7.5 metres of the natural boundary of a tidal area.

A new or replacement seawall must meet the City's seawall design requirements: crest elevation of 4.1 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada datum, designed so the crest can be raised a further 1.4 metres in the future, a wave deflector, erosion protection at the toe, and construction on private property.

Delta's small-scale multi-unit housing zoning, adopted June 24, 2024, allows up to four units on single-detached and duplex lots city-wide, subject to the bylaw and to any hazard permit area on the lot.

blocks.text: Beach Grove: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Beach Grove Park at 6051 17A Avenue is listed by the City with dawn-to-dusk hours and picnic tables, playgrounds, sport courts, tennis courts, trails, washrooms and an off-leash area.

The City is the diking authority here and operates and maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure across Delta.

Route 601 serves Boundary Bay on trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street to 1A Avenue, continuing via South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station on the Canada Line.

A seawall on a Beach Grove lot is the owner's structure, not the City's: the City's design form requires the seawall to be constructed on private property and certified by a structural engineer for flood protection integrity.

blocks.text: Beach Grove: development and new projects

items.t: Beach Grove Flood Protection Improvements, Beach Grove Seawall, 12 Avenue to 17A Avenue, City of Delta: condition assessment and concept design for seawall upgrades, with a public open house held February 8, 2023 and the final report released — STATUS: final report released, detailed design and construction subject to senior-government funding, read 2026-11-03.

The area-specific cost here is the seawall: a new seawall design must meet the 4.1 metre crest standard and be built on private property, and an existing seawall needs engineer certification of its structural and flood protection integrity — both are owner-side costs a buyer should price before removing subjects.
The Speculation and Vacancy Tax applies in Delta, a listed Metro Vancouver taxable area.

Route 601 links this shore to Bridgeport Station on the Canada Line via South Delta Exchange, Ladner Exchange, Highway 17 and Highway 99, with Boundary Bay trips running via 12 Avenue and Boundary Bay Road.
The dike trail is the local walking and cycling route: 17 kilometres along Boundary Bay between 17A Avenue and Mud Bay Park, per Metro Vancouver.
12 Avenue is the road out of the pocket, west to 56 Street and the Tsawwassen town centre, and east into Boundary Bay Regional Park.

blocks.text: Beach Grove: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check on DeltaMap whether the specific lot falls inside Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 before offering; DeltaMap shows flood protection, permit areas, Agricultural Land Reserve status and lot dimensions by parcel.

Ask for the seawall's engineer certification and any flood covenant on title: the City requires certification of structural and flood protection integrity for existing seawalls, and its general pages do not certify any individual lot's wall.
Check title through the Land Title and Survey Authority: the City states title charges can affect a property's use or redevelopment.

faq.a: The City treats Beach Grove as a named flood-risk community. Its December 27, 2022 advisory expected high water with strong southeast winds to elevate flood risk for Beach Grove and Boundary Bay, moved the area to Stage 3 of its Staged Flood Preparedness Plan with portable pumps and generators, and placed sandbags at Seaview Road, the 1A Avenue boat launch, 3rd Avenue and 16th Avenue beach accesses.

faq.a: The Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore, and private moorage or dock use sits on tenure by lease or licence through FrontCounter BC, under General Permission or Specific Permission — not on land the seller owns. Budget and title checks for a waterfront lot should include the foreshore tenure position, not just the upland parcel.
